As a cleanroom assembly technician, you will work at a new location of a high-tech company in Nuenen. You will join a small team of 3 colleagues, but the company has big plans to expand the department in the near future. Since the location is still new, you will also help set up and organize the workspace in the beginning.Your main responsibility will be assembling complex mechatronic modules and systems using technical drawings and work instructions.
